d:
Hey all. I've been working on this off and on since the original gallery came up. I figured with Fortune's Weave coming out this week, I should just bite the bullet and finish it. Please note that, as I tried to stay as true as possible to the original's formatting, some of the pages may be...harder to follow than others (I believe it was Taporitan Shokudou's first major work). I did however, color-code the dialogue, as it was not originally color-coded, and therefore harder to understand who was saying what. Please also note that, as I stated, I've been working off and on it in between Purple haze edits, there may be some slight differences from when I was more or less experienced. Seagult was also less experienced when they gave me the translation. I hope this doesn't detract too much. Please enjoy.

Translated by: Seagult

Edited and Proofread by: Gintokiftw
